document.cue: Describe an important exam you took.

text: The most important exam I've taken so far was the UNT — the Unified National Test — which every school leaver in Kazakhstan sits to get into university. I took it in June after my final year at school, and the score decided whether I'd get a state grant or have to pay for my studies.

I prepared for it for almost a whole year. Besides my normal lessons, I went to a test preparation centre three evenings a week, where we did practice papers under timed conditions. At home I made a strict timetable and focused mainly on maths and history, which were my weakest subjects.

The day itself was quite intense. We had to arrive very early, hand in our phones and go through a security check, and I remember my hands were shaking when I opened the first section. But after twenty minutes or so I calmed down, because the questions looked familiar from all that practice.
When the results came out, I'd scored well above what I needed for a grant. I felt a huge sense of relief, and I was proud that all those long evenings at the preparation centre had paid off.
Looking back, it taught me that steady preparation matters far more than luck, which is exactly how I'm approaching IELTS now.

tips.en: Which every school leaver in Kazakhstan sits explains the exam in one clause.
tips.kk: Which every school leaver in Kazakhstan sits — бір сөйлем ҰБТ-ның не екенін түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Which every school leaver in Kazakhstan sits — одна фраза объясняет, что такое ЕНТ.
tips.example: which every school leaver in Kazakhstan sits to get into university

tips.en: My hands were shaking is stronger than “I was nervous”.
tips.kk: My hands were shaking — «I was nervous» дегеннен күштірек.
tips.ru: My hands were shaking — сильнее, чем «I was nervous».

note.en: “With a strict time limit, like the real exam”.
What the exam was and when — with an explanation for an examiner who may not know the UNT.
note.kk: Қандай емтихан және қашан — ҰБТ-ны білмеуі мүмкін емтихан алушыға түсіндірмемен.
note.ru: Что за экзамен и когда — с пояснением для экзаменатора, который может не знать ЕНТ.

note.en: How the speaker prepared — specific: where, how often a week, which subjects.
note.kk: Қалай дайындалды — нақты: қайда, аптасына неше рет, қай пәндер.
note.ru: Как готовился — конкретно: где, сколько раз в неделю, какие предметы.

note.en: The day itself — feelings shown through details (shaking hands).
note.kk: Емтихан күні — сезім деректер арқылы (қолдың дірілдеуі).
note.ru: Сам день экзамена — чувства через детали (дрожащие руки).

note.en: The last bullet — feelings about the result — gets its own paragraph.
note.kk: Соңғы тармақ — нәтижеге қатынас — жеке абзацта.
note.ru: Последний пункт — отношение к результату — отдельным абзацем.

note.en: A lesson for the future — a short conclusion without “That’s all”.
note.kk: Болашаққа сабақ — «That’s all» деместен қысқа қорытынды.
note.ru: Урок на будущее — короткий вывод без «That’s all».
